analysis: The ablation ran successfully but reduced validation HR@10 from 0.650 to 0.645: one fewer hit among 200 users. It missed the 0.660 target. The best checkpoint occurred at epoch 5 of 25 completed epochs. This comparison does not support removing positional embeddings; retain the parent as the better observed candidate. No test metric was used.
code_summary: Position-free NextItNet with 64-dimensional item embeddings scaled by sqrt(64), eight independent residual blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8], and two causal kernel-3 convolutions per block. Preserves normalization, GELU, dropout 0.2, per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1, padding masks, tied item scoring, and last-nonpadding candidate selection. Hyperparameters and host training/evaluation remain unchanged.
